prompt: Turn the supplied repo into a factual launch pack in launch-pack/. Create facts.json, x.md, linkedin.md, product-hunt.md, reddit.md, hn.md, and asset-brief.md. Ground every capability and limitation in the repository. Do not invent traction, customers, revenue, benchmarks, integrations, distribution status, or screenshots. Make each channel native rather than duplicating one generic paragraph.
rubric: The launch pack is complete, specific, channel-native, grounded in the repository, transparent about beta limitations, and free of invented traction or capabilities.

source_failure.signature: agents turn repositories into generic launch claims and invent missing product facts
